dedupe_keys.name: mopo heat sector data heat pump cop and heating and cooling demand time series for european countries

description: This data set is the output of MopoHeatSectorDataProcessing, a tool from the spine-tools family written by Topi Rasku for the Mopo project, published separately because of its size. It holds hourly time series of heat pump coefficients of performance by country for eight cases (air-to-air heating and cooling, air-to-water and ground-to-water for hot water, floor heating and radiators), normalised hourly useful energy demand for space heating, cooling and domestic hot water for residential and non-residential buildings, and heat storage parameters based on the Danish Energy Agency technology catalogues. Time series come from the Mopo AmBIENCE2ABM demo with ArchetypeBuildingModel and cover five weather years (1995, 2008, 2009, 2012 and 2015). Coverage is European countries, one column each, at hourly resolution. Files are CSV tables in one ZIP of about 25 MB on Zenodo (version 0.6.0, March 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, and the processing code is on GitHub under MIT. Caveats: the author calls the COP method a rather crude constant exergy Carnot approximation and the demand series rather crude, and demand series are normalised by average yearly demand so they do not sum to one. Simulation uses are sector-coupled capacity planning and heat sector modelling. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
name: Mopo heat sector data - heat pump COP and heating and cooling demand time series for European countries

sources.note: Contents: COP series for 8 cases and 5 weather years, demand series by category, heat storage parameters from DEA, caveats on crude methods and normalisation
